compatibility.api: API 1.3.0 serves the same catalog GET requests with the existing parameters, responses and rate limits.
compatibility.mcp: MCP 1.3.1 keeps the same four tool names and argument schemas. UTCP uses the native HTTP search parameter q.
compatibility.sdk: SDK 0.3.2 and both aliases keep their published versions and exact pins. The UTCP client calls the catalog directly over HTTP.
compatibility.skill: Catalog skill 1.3.2 keeps its published bytes and SDK install command. Developers can connect a UTCP client through the public quickstart.
compatibility.a2a: A2A 1.0.0 keeps its existing selection skill and endpoint.
compatibility.website: Website 1.7.0 adds the UTCP manual and connection instructions.
compatibility.ucp: UCP 1.0.0 retains its signed partner catalog and buyer handoff.
compatibility.utcp: Manual 1.0.0 uses the UTCP 1.0.1 HTTP tool format. Each tool reads the public catalog without credentials.
